T0575.title: Push Bombing
T0575.definition: Repeated delivery of authentication or approval prompts intended to pressure users into consent.
T0575.description: Push bombing floods a user with login or approval notifications to pressure accidental consent. It can support account takeover, enterprise VPN intrusion, and approval of privileged actions. Controls focus on challenge throttling, risky-login blocking, clear request-origin display, and abnormal-approval alerts.
T0575.usageExample: Assess Push Bombing related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
